name: session-hub
description: A right-hand panel: tasks, your other sessions (message, rename, see who needs you), links, service checks, and your status line

pollSeconds.title: Refresh every (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the session list refreshes. 0 refreshes only when you open the pane or press Refresh.

awaySeconds.title: Ping after turns longer than (seconds)
awaySeconds.description: A finished turn at least this long sends a push to your phone (or a chime if you're at the desk). 0 turns it off.

pingPeerFinish.title: Ping when a peer session finishes
pingPeerFinish.description: Push or chime when another session goes from working to idle.

deskSound.title: Chime when you're at the desk
deskSound.description: Play a Windows sound instead of a phone push when Claude Code sees you're present.

sidebar.title: Panel on the right in fullscreen
sidebar.description: In the fullscreen layout (/tui fullscreen), dock the panel (session tabs above, status line below) on the right instead of the band.

panelPercent.title: Panel width (% of the terminal)
panelPercent.description: The panel's share of the terminal when it opens: 30 is a 7:3 split. 15 to 60; a width you drag the panel to wins.

services.title: Services tab
services.description: Comma-separated name=URL pairs to watch, e.g. gpu=http://my-pc:8188, ollama=http://localhost:11434. A ComfyUI address also shows its GPU, free VRAM and queue. Empty hides the tab.

showBand.title: Show the sessions band above the prompt
showBand.description: A one-line summary of your sessions with an Open button.
